name: NGC 185 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 185, a dwarf satellite galaxy of the Andromeda galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc185-hubble
story: A small companion of the Andromeda galaxy, NGC 185 holds clouds of dust near its center. This view is aimed at one of its globular star clusters, part of a study comparing the clusters of small galaxies with those in the halos of Andromeda and the Milky Way.

claims.text: NGC 185 (Caldwell 18) is a dwarf galaxy and satellite of the Andromeda galaxy
NGC 185 is a dwarf elliptical satellite of M31
Dust clouds near the galaxy's center
This pointing targets a globular cluster in NGC 185
The program compares dwarf-galaxy globular clusters with accreted cluster families in the M31 and Milky Way halos
